1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Consortium: In case of Contracts, wherein the seller alone does not have necessary expertise, the seller can form consortium with other sellers for submission of the bid, with one of the consortium company as leader. However, each and every member of the consortium shall be equally responsible for the complete execution of the project contract. An undertaking to this effect is to be uploaded with bid. 4. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of ACCOUNTS OFFICER (A &P) (COLLECTION) payable at GUWAHATI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of ACCOUNTS OFFICER (A &P) (COLLECTION) payable at

GUWAHATI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name ACCOUNTS OFFICER (A &P) (COLLECTION) Account No. 380601010350425 IFSC Code UBIN0538060 Bank Name UNION BANK Branch address CHANDMARI, GUWAHATI . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text-based ATC clauses for Integrated SLA Based Maintenance Tender for KAMRU P BA, BSNL ASSAM for Mtce of OFC route, Tx Equipment & associated accessories, L1 Mtce of Power Infra O&M Exchange/BTS site BSNL, BTS Site Upkeep & L1 Engg Mtce, AC & DG Compreh ensive Mtce. The bidder should carefully note and accept following 1. The bidder must submit all the required documents as mentioned in Clause 4 of the “Buyer Added Bi d Specific ATC” document. 2. The bidder shall submit all the declarations and annexures as required in the terms mentioned in “B uyer Added Bid Specific ATC” as well as Bid document duly signed with date & stamp. 3. The bidder should upload the scanned copies from original documents ONLY as mentioned in the Bid & annexures during online bid submission. 4. In case, at any stage, the declarations & annexures submitted by the bidder are found to be false or i ncorrect, the BSNL shall be free to take any punitive/legal action against the company, as may be deemed fit, which shall be acceptable/binding on the company leading to cancellation of the contract. 5. The bidder should accept all the terms & conditions mentioned in the GeM bid document as well as t he “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document. 6. The successful selected vendors should accept and process the GeM Contract within 5 days of issue of the GeM Contract by the buyer. Without acceptance of the GeM Contract by the seller within the stipulat ed time, the GeM Contract will be cancelled by the buyer without any further intimation. 7. The successful selected vendors must comply with the Tender Technical Specifications and all the ter ms & conditions mentioned in the GeM bid document, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC as well as the GeM Co ntract. No deviations shall be entertained unless specifically mentioned. 8. The successful selected bidders shall submit Performance Security in the form of ePBG within 14 day s from the date of issue of the GeM Contract as mentioned in Clause 11 of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific A TC” document. BG issuing bank must send the BG advice via SFMS (Structural Financial Messaging System ) as provided by RBI. Duration of ePBG validity, amount and beneficiary are mentioned in the GeM bid doc ument. Format of the ePBG shall be automatically provided by the GeM portal itself upon award of the Ge M Contract. 9. BSNL shall not be liable to pay any interest on any of the BGs mentioned above.

10. Currently, there is no payment method under TReDS (Trade Receivables Discounting System) is being followed by BSNL. Hence, for submission of Invoice(s)/Bill(s) by successful vendor, kindly refer to Clause 1 4, 15 & 16 of the “Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC” document for further details. 11. Tax Indemnity Clause: BSNL has the right to recover from the supplier any Input Tax Credit loss suffer ed by it due to any mis-declaration on invoice by the supplier. Also, the supplier must have GST registratio n for the tendered service mentioned in the item category. 12. Bidder must mandatorily quote the total price of the work inclusive of GST and all Taxes in GeM portal, based on the data (Quantity, corresponding rates and total Estimated cost etc) given in the " PRICE SCHED ULE" Table of “Scope of Work” of the GeM bid document. 13. The rate quoted by the bidder in the financial bid as well as the final rate after the completion of RA (R everse Auction) shall be applicable on pro-rata basis on all the line items of the Price Schedule BOQ. 14. This GeM Bid/Tender has been floated on Project/ Lumpsum based. So there will be no scope of chang e in the GeM contract value or quantity during generation of GeM Contract. Hence the quantities in the Pri ce Schedule and values in the Purchase Orders may be deviated upto 50% (increase/decrease) after gener ation of GeM Contract, on the basis of actual quantity decided after joint inspection of the officers of the co ncerned field unit and the successful bidder. 15. The quantity of item given in Sl No. 3.5 of the Price Schedule given in scope of work is on yearly basis hence may not come under the scope of regular monthly billing rather included in the bill of corresponding month only after execution of work under the line item as per quantity of actual execution. 16. The quantity given in the Price Schedule of the SoW document attached in the Tender Document are th e tentative quantities and the payment will be done on the actual work done as per quantity of the line ite ms, mutually agreed by the field units and vendor during HOTO. 17. BSNL as a buyer reserves the right to cancel the tender at any stage of the tender without assigning an y reason to anybody whatsoever and the decision of buyer in this respect shall be final and binding and sh all not be liable to be questioned in any court or before any authority. 18. BSNL reserves the right to short close the contract at any time during contract period, due to administr ative reasons with a notice of 30 days and the decision of BSNL in this respect shall be final and binding to Bidder and shall not be liable to be questioned in any court or before any authority. 19. The Period of Contract is for 2 year and can be extended by BSNL for further 1 year, with mutual consent on the same rate and terms and conditions. Bank G uarantee already available with BSNL, shall be got extended accordingly. . 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
